hooks.name: Session Baseline
hooks.description: Records the working tree at session start so the Stop hook can tell what THIS session changed. Without it, `git diff --name-only HEAD` reports every file carrying uncommitted work from before the session, which on 2026-08-26 made three consecutive Stop hooks run getDiagnostics over 13 .rs files in a session whose only edit was markdown. Uses content hashes rather than a diff, so a commit during the session does not invalidate the baseline. Silent always; fails open.
